say:1:1430227401:1.text: As a nobleman, I can lower my requirements for my meals.
say:1:1430227401:1.source_cn: 作为一名贵族，我可以降低我对食物的要求。
say:1:1430227401:1.male: As a nobleman, I can lower my requirements for my meals.
say:1:1430227401:1.female: As a nobleman, I can lower my requirements for my meals.

say:2:1430227402:1.text: However, I would never do manual labor for food. For a noble, some lines can never be crossed.

say:2:1430227402:1.female: However, I would never do manual labor for food. For a noble, some lines can never be crossed.
